question: Among all cards that have rulings and are not textless, what percentage have at least one foreign language version in Japanese?

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese' THEN c.XCL_072 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
  / COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_072) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
  ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
WHERE c.XCL_022 = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.XCL_090 = c.XCL_072
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS fd2
    WHERE fd2.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
  )

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese' THEN c.XCL_072 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
  / COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_072) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
  ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
WHERE c.XCL_022 = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.XCL_090 = c.XCL_072
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM foreign_data AS fd2
    WHERE fd2.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
  )
